Class SpringHandlerInstantiator

java.lang.Object
com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.cfg.HandlerInstantiator
org.springframework.http.converter.json.SpringHandlerInstantiator
@Deprecated(since="7.0", forRemoval=true) public class SpringHandlerInstantiator extends com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.cfg.HandlerInstantiator
Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
自 7.0 版本起，推荐使用JacksonHandlerInstantiator。
Allows for creating Jackson 2.x (JsonSerializer, JsonDeserializer, KeyDeserializer, TypeResolverBuilder, TypeIdResolver) beans with autowiring against a Spring ApplicationContext.

自 Spring 4.3 起，此方法覆盖了 `HandlerInstantiator` 中的所有工厂方法，包括非抽象方法和 Jackson 2.4 及 2.5 中最近引入的方法：针对 `ValueInstantiator`、`ObjectIdGenerator`、`ObjectIdResolver`、`PropertyNamingStrategy`、`Converter` 和 `VirtualBeanPropertyWriter`。

Since:
4.1.3
Author:
Sebastien Deleuze, Juergen Hoeller
